- [USER] User asked if AR technology will become a standard feature for businesses in the future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AR technology is expected to become a standard feature for businesses due to its benefits in improving customer engagement, enhancing shopping experiences, and driving sales growth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As AR technology becomes more advanced and accessible, more businesses will implement AR features on websites, mobile apps, and in-store experiences.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As consumers become familiar with AR, businesses will need to adapt to remain competitive.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The trend of businesses adopting AR technology is expected to grow in the coming years, making it a standard feature for providing engaging and immersive customer experiences.
